verdict.rationale: Convex documents a public HTTP API for calling deployment functions and a CLI `npx convex run` command, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path, which also rules out a spec-driven interactive explorer. A CLI command for running your own functions is not an explorable API reference, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
